barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player heat crosses 75% of capacity
lines: Heat at seventy-five percent. Dissipation holding.
Thermal load rising. Recommend fire discipline.
Core temperature elevated. Margins narrowing.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player heat crosses 85% of capacity
lines: Heat at eighty-five percent. Redline approaching.
Thermal margin closing. Ease your weapons.
Approaching redline. Suggest a pause in fire.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player fires continuously for six-plus seconds while above 60% heat
lines: Sustained fire exceeds dissipation. This is not indefinitely viable.
Heat generation is outpacing your sinks. Plan your window.
You are spending heat faster than I can shed it.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player discharges the coolant flush pod with F
lines: Coolant flush discharged. Core temperature falling.
Flush pod expended. That was the only one.
Emergency coolant released. Thermal margin restored.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player enters a biome with reduced heat dissipation, such as the salt desert
lines: Ambient temperature high. Heat sink efficiency reduced to eighty percent.
This terrain sheds heat poorly. Adjust your rhythm.
Warning: dissipation degraded by ambient conditions.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player enters arctic cold or heavy rain where dissipation improves
lines: Ambient cold detected. Heat sink efficiency improved.
Conditions favor your coolant loop. Use the margin wisely.
Dissipation running above baseline. Noted.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player heat crosses 95% of capacity
lines: Redline. Shutdown imminent.
Thermal limit reached. Cease fire or lose the core.
Critical heat. I will shut us down to protect the reactor.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: One and a half seconds before auto-shutdown triggers
lines: Shutdown in three. Two.
Core protection engaging. Brace.
Thermal interlock tripping. Stand by.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Automatic emergency shutdown begins
lines: Emergency shutdown. Reactor safing. Please remain calm.
Powering down. We are blind and still until relight.
Core offline. Restart cycle beginning shortly.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Restart sequence begins after a shutdown
lines: Restart sequence initiated. Coolant loop stabilizing.
Reactor relight in progress. Hold.
Bringing the core back. Boards repopulating.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Systems return to full power after a shutdown
lines: Restart complete. All boards answer ready.
Core reignited. Weapons live. Move.
We are back, Lodestar. Mind the heat this time.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player holds O to override thermal shutdown
lines: Override accepted. Thermal damage accruing.
Shutdown suppressed. This will cost us internals.
Override logged. I trust the target is worth it.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Internal damage ticking while override is held
lines: Internal structure degrading. Heat is eating the frame.
Actuator housings warping. Recommend release.
Damage accumulating in the core cradle.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Override held with live ammunition aboard, cook-off chance active
lines: Magazine temperature critical. Cook-off probability rising.
Ammunition unstable. This may become sudden.
Warning: the magazines are approaching self-ignition.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player releases override and heat falls below redline
lines: Override released. Thermal levels recovering.
Interlock restored. Logging structural cost.
Returning to safe operation. Noted for the maintenance report.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: A player weapon is destroyed by a critical hit
lines: Weapon destroyed. Group assignments updated.
We have lost a hardpoint. Rebalancing fire groups.
That mount is gone. Adjusting solutions.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: An actuator takes critical damage
lines: Actuator damage. Expect resistance in the affected limb.
Servo response degraded. Compensating where I can.
Limb articulation impaired. Adjust your footwork.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: The gyro takes critical damage, inducing sway
lines: Gyro damaged. Stability envelope reduced.
Balance compensation degraded. Step carefully.
Gyro fault. Sudden turns may put us down.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Sensor suite takes critical damage, radar fuzzed
lines: Sensor suite damaged. Contacts may be unreliable.
Radar returns degraded. Trust your eyes.
Target data intermittent. Compensating.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: An ammunition cook-off chain detonates inside the player mech
lines: Ammunition cook-off. Sealing what remains.
Magazine detonation. Structure compromised.
Internal explosion contained. Barely.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player left arm is severed
lines: Left arm severed. Hardpoints lost with it.
We have lost the left arm at the shoulder.
Left arm off. Mass balance updated.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player right arm is severed
lines: Right arm severed. Weapon groups rebuilt.
The right arm is gone. Adjusting recoil model.
Right arm off. Fight with what remains.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: One player leg is destroyed, speed capped
lines: Leg destroyed. Speed capped. Compensating gait.
We are down to one good leg. I will keep us upright.
Locomotion critical. Limp protocol engaged.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: A side torso is destroyed, taking the attached arm
lines: Side torso destroyed. The arm went with it.
Torso section lost. Attached systems offline.
Flank structure gone. We are lighter now, and not in a good way.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player destroys an enemy mech by any standard means
lines: Target destroyed.
Hostile reactor down. Confirmed.
Kill confirmed. Updating tactical picture.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player kills an enemy mech by cockpit destruction
lines: Cockpit strike. Pilot neutralized. Chassis intact.
Head destroyed. Salvage value: excellent.
Precision kill confirmed. The frame is recoverable.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player kills an enemy mech by destroying both legs
lines: Mobility kill. Target immobilized and silent.
Target legged. It is not going anywhere.
Kill by immobilization. Prime salvage condition.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Any ammunition-fed weapon falls below 25% reserves
lines: Ammunition at one quarter. Plan accordingly.
Magazine reserves low. Recommend conservation.
Ballistic stores at twenty-five percent.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: A weapon runs completely out of ammunition
lines: Weapon dry. Group updated.
Ammunition expended. That trigger now does nothing.
Stores exhausted for that mount.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player takes hits on rear armor
lines: Impact, rear armor. We are being flanked.
Fire from behind. Recommend you turn.
Rear arc under attack. Armor there is thin.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: An armor zone is stripped and internal structure exposed
lines: Armor breach. Internal structure exposed.
Plate integrity lost. The next hits go deep.
We are open to the frame. Suggest cover.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Enemy missile lock acquired on the player
lines: Missile lock detected. Tracking source.
Inbound lock. Recommend cover or ECM.
We are being painted. Missiles likely.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Heavy impacts push the player toward knockdown threshold
lines: Stability critical. Brace or fall.
Impact momentum exceeding gyro limits.
We are close to going down. Widen your stance.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: A fireteam mech is disabled or destroyed
lines: Fireteam signal lost. Their reactor is down.
A friendly telemetry feed has flatlined.
Fireteam mech disabled. Position marked.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player opens the tactical map or requests a squad summary
lines: Fireteam telemetry nominal. All feeds green.
Squad status: operational. Minor armor loss recorded.
All fireteam boards answer. Proceeding.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: An enemy wreck is marked salvageable after combat
lines: Wreck catalogued. Recovery teams notified.
Salvage beacon placed. The Compact will collect.
Chassis logged for recovery. Condition: acceptable.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: High-quality salvage logged from a legged or headshot kill
lines: Salvage condition: prime. Minimal structural loss.
That kill preserved the frame. Well executed.
Recovery value high. The technicians will be pleased.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: A new objective becomes active
lines: Objective updated. Marker on your display.
New tasking received. Route plotted.
Objective logged. Guidance available.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: All primary objectives are complete
lines: All primary objectives complete. Well done, Lodestar.
Mission parameters satisfied. Logging outcome.
Objectives green across the board.

barks.speaker: CAIRN
barks.trigger: Player reaches an intermediate navigation point
lines: Nav point reached. Next marker set.
Waypoint confirmed. Continue on heading.
Position verified. Updating route.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Player issues Form Up (F1) to Sable
lines: Coming.
On you.
Closing.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Player issues Attack My Target (F2) to Sable
lines: Marked. Firing.
On it.
Target accepted.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Player issues Hold Position (F3) to Sable
lines: Holding.
Set.
I won't move.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Player issues Move To (F4) to Sable
lines: Moving.
Relocating.
On my way.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Sable destroys an enemy
lines: Down.
One less.
Target's quiet.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Sable scores a cockpit kill at range
lines: Head shot. Clean.
Pilot's gone. Frame's whole.
Through the glass.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Sable takes incoming fire
lines: Taking fire. Adjusting.
They found me.
Under fire. Not hit yet.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Sable is under sustained heavy fire
lines: Pinned. Could use eyes off me.
Heavy fire. Repositioning.
Too much incoming. Moving.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Sable's ammunition runs low
lines: Ammo's thin.
Six rounds. Making them count.
Running low. Choosing shots.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Status check while Sable is healthy
lines: Green.
Intact.
Still here.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Status check while Sable is significantly damaged
lines: Armor's open. Managing.
Took some. Functional.
Hit, not stopped.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Player mech is visibly running hot near Sable
lines: You're glowing, Lodestar.
Heat bloom off your frame. Careful.
I can see you on thermal from here. So can they.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Sable loses a weapon to a critical hit
lines: Lost my long gun. Switching.
Weapon's gone. Still useful.
Mount's dead. Adapting.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Player loses an arm or leg while Sable is on comms
lines: You lost a limb. Adjust.
Saw it come off. Stay behind me.
You're leaking parts, Lodestar.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Player mech shuts down in combat near Sable
lines: Lodestar's dark. Covering.
Shutdown. I have overwatch.
Stay down. I see them all.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Post-combat salvage tally near Sable
lines: Good frames out there.
Clean kills. Worth collecting.
The wrecks will feed us.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Long stretch of a mission passes without contact
lines: Too quiet.
Nothing moving. Yet.
I don't trust this.

barks.speaker: Sable
barks.trigger: Sable spots distant enemy movement before anyone else
lines: Movement. Two kilometers. Ridge line.
Contact, far. They haven't seen us.
Eyes up. We're not alone.

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Player issues Form Up (F1) to Tremor
lines: Coming to you, big and loud!
On my way! Try not to start without me.
Forming up. Somebody keep my spot warm.

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Player issues Attack My Target (F2) to Tremor
lines: HA! That one's mine now!
Say goodnight to it, Lodestar!
Copy! Introducing myself with a cannon!

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Player issues Hold Position (F3) to Tremor
lines: Holding! Like a mountain holds!
This is my ground now. Come take it from me.
Not moving. You couldn't tow me off this spot.

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Player issues Move To (F4) to Tremor
lines: Moving! Feel that? That's me walking!
On the march! Clear a path!
Going! The ground will tell you where I am.

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Tremor destroys an enemy
lines: DOWN! Ha ha! Did you feel it fall?
Scratch one! That's for Veyra!
It's scrap now! Beautiful, beautiful scrap!

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Tremor kills an enemy at point-blank range
lines: Close enough to shake hands! HA!
Right in its face! That's how it's done!
I looked in its cockpit and said goodbye!

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Tremor takes incoming fire
lines: They're shooting me! Rude!
Taking hits! Armor's earning its pay!
That stings! Now I'm annoyed!

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Tremor is focused by multiple enemies
lines: Okay, that's a LOT of guns pointed at me!
Heavy fire! Could use a friendly cannon over here!
They really want me dead! Flattering! Unpleasant!

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Tremor's ammunition runs low
lines: Running dry! Save some scrap for my fists!
Ammo's low! When I get quiet, you worry!
Counting shells now! Never a good sign!

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Status check while Tremor is healthy
lines: Never better! Well. Rarely better!
All green! The paint's ruined, though.
Still standing! Takes more than that!

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Status check while Tremor is significantly damaged
lines: I've been chewed on, but I'm chewing back!
Armor's open. Don't tell my knees.
Hurt, not done. Big difference!

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Player loses a limb while Tremor is on comms
lines: Lodestar's hit bad! Get behind me, NOW!
They took your arm — I'll take their everything!
Fall back to me, friend. I'm wide enough for both of us.

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Tremor loses a weapon to a critical hit
lines: Lost a gun! Still got the other, still got attitude!
My cannon's dead. Moment of silence... okay, done. FIGHTING!
One mount down! The rest of me disagrees with retreat!

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Player mech shuts down in combat near Tremor
lines: Lodestar's down — form a wall! NOBODY touches them!
Shutdown! You stand on them, I stand on you!
Cover the boss! I'm the biggest thing here — shoot ME!

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Post-combat salvage tally near Tremor
lines: Look at all this beautiful junk! We're rich!
The techs are going to kiss us! Every one of us!
That's a month of parts lying there! Good work!

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: Player mech is visibly running hot near Tremor
lines: You're cooking, Lodestar! Ease off before you pop!
I can feel your heat from here! Breathe!
Steam bath's over, friend! Let it cool!

barks.speaker: Tremor
barks.trigger: An advance or push phase of the mission begins
lines: Now THIS is the good part! Forward!
You hear drums? Those are my footsteps! Let's GO!
Advance! First one there wins nothing! Go anyway!

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Player issues Form Up (F1) to Vireo, early campaign
lines: Okay — okay, coming to you!
Forming up! Don't go too fast, please.
On my way — watch my left, someone?

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Player issues Form Up (F1) to Vireo, late campaign, steadier
lines: Forming up.
Coming. Covering the rear.
On you, Lodestar.

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Player issues Attack My Target (F2) to Vireo, early campaign
lines: That one? Okay. Okay, engaging!
Attacking — I hope this works —
Copy, firing! Sorry — firing!

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Player issues Attack My Target (F2) to Vireo, late campaign, steadier
lines: Target accepted. Engaging.
On it. Watch my tracers.
Copy. It's already dead, it just doesn't know.

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Player issues Hold Position (F3) to Vireo, early campaign
lines: Holding! Holding here. Right here.
Copy, hold — for how long, roughly? Asking for my nerves.
Position held! I'm not moving. Definitely not.

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Player issues Move To (F4) to Vireo, early campaign
lines: Moving there — is it safe? It's not, is it.
Okay, relocating! Quickly!
Copy, moving — someone watch that ridge?

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Player issues Move To (F4) to Vireo, late campaign, steadier
lines: Moving. Route looks clean.
Relocating now.
Copy. In transit.

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Vireo destroys an enemy, early campaign
lines: I got it! I actually — target down!
It's down! Is it down? It's down!
Kill confirmed! Oh, wow. Okay. Breathing.

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Vireo destroys an enemy, late campaign, steadier
lines: Target down.
Kill confirmed. Next.
That's another one for the Compact.

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Vireo finishes off a target the player damaged
lines: Finished yours off! Team effort — mostly you.
Got the one you softened! Thanks for the head start!
Your target's down — I helped! A little!

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Vireo takes incoming fire, early campaign
lines: Taking fire! Taking fire! Not loving it!
They're shooting at ME — why me?!
Incoming! Armor's holding — I think — it's holding!

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Vireo takes incoming fire, late campaign, steadier
lines: Taking fire. Holding my line.
Under fire. Returning it.
They've picked me. Their mistake.

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Vireo's ammunition runs low
lines: Ammo's low — I counted twice — it's low!
Running out! Saving the rest for emergencies. This is an emergency, isn't it.
Low on rounds. Making each one matter. Trying to.

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Status check while Vireo is healthy, early campaign
lines: I'm okay! Mostly okay! Green, technically!
Still here! All limbs attached — mine and the mech's!
Status green! Heart rate... less green.

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Status check while Vireo is healthy, late campaign, steadier
lines: Green across the board.
Fully operational.
Standing and dangerous.

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Status check while Vireo is significantly damaged
lines: I'm hit — armor's open on my right — managing it!
Took a bad one. Still combat capable. I checked.
Damaged but standing! Repeat, standing!

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Player loses a limb while Vireo is on comms
lines: Lodestar! Your — okay, you're still up, you're still up!
That looked bad! Tell me what you need!
Limb's off — I'm covering your weak side!

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Vireo loses a weapon to a critical hit
lines: Lost my launcher! I still have — okay, I still have one gun!
Weapon's dead! Improvising! Can you improvise in a mech?
Mount destroyed. Still fighting. It's fine. It's fine.

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Player mech shuts down in combat near Vireo
lines: Lodestar's dark! Somebody — okay, ME, I'm covering!
Shutdown! Standing over you — nobody gets through me! Probably!
Powered down — hold on, we've got you!

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Post-combat salvage tally near Vireo
lines: That's... a lot of salvage. We did that?
The wrecks are ours! Tagging everything!
Salvage teams are going to love us!

barks.speaker: Vireo
barks.trigger: Player mech is visibly running hot near Vireo
lines: Lodestar, your heat — the vents are glowing!
You're running hot! Really hot! Statistically dangerous hot!
Heat warning — yours, not mine! Please cool down!

barks.speaker: Relay
barks.trigger: A new objective is transmitted mid-mission
lines: New tasking on your map, Lodestar. Try to look surprised.
Objective update — marker's live. It's the big obvious one.
Fresh orders coming through. Painting it now.

barks.speaker: Relay
barks.trigger: An objective is completed and verified
lines: Objective complete. Confirmed and logged. Nicely done.
That's a tick in the box. Next item, coming up.
Done and verified. I'll tell the Commander you made it look easy.

barks.speaker: Relay
barks.trigger: Enemy reinforcements detected inbound
lines: Heads up — fresh hostiles inbound. They sound annoyed.
Reinforcements on the board. The Directorate doesn't like losing.
More contacts en route. You're popular today, Lodestar.

barks.speaker: Relay
barks.trigger: Extraction point becomes active
lines: Extraction's hot. Straight line, no sightseeing.
Ride's waiting. Recommend you be on it.
Exfil marker's up. The barge won't idle forever.

barks.speaker: Relay
barks.trigger: Relay intercepts enemy communications mid-mission
lines: Intercepting their traffic — they're rattled. Good.
Enemy net's lit up about you. All complaints.
Directorate comms just changed cipher. That means you scared someone important.

barks.speaker: Relay
barks.trigger: Hidden hostiles open fire on the fireteam
lines: Ambush! Contacts were masked — I see them NOW, sorry!
That's an ambush — sources marked, return the favor!
They were hiding in the clutter. Marked. Make them regret it.

barks.speaker: Relay
barks.trigger: Strafing aircraft begin an attack run on the fireteam
lines: Air inbound! Fast movers, vector north — get under something!
Strafing run coming. Twenty seconds. Move, move!
Aircraft on attack run — break their line, don't stand in it!

barks.speaker: Relay
barks.trigger: Player destroys a heavy or named enemy unit
lines: That was their heavy! Scratch one nightmare!
Big kill confirmed — their whole net just went quiet.
You dropped their anchor unit. The rest will wobble. Push!

barks.speaker: Relay
barks.trigger: Last hostile in an engagement is destroyed
lines: Board's clear. No movers, no signals.
That's the last of them. Area's yours.
All hostiles down. Take a breath — you've earned ten seconds.

barks.speaker: Relay
barks.trigger: Post-engagement salvage summary is compiled
lines: Salvage tally coming in — respectable haul, Lodestar.
Recovery teams dispatched. They say thanks, in advance.
Logging the wrecks. The quartermaster might actually smile.

barks.speaker: Relay
barks.trigger: Prime-condition salvage is logged
lines: Ooh — intact chassis. That's a payday.
Prime salvage on the board. Barely a scratch on it. Nice shooting.
That frame's nearly showroom. The techs will fight over it.

barks.speaker: Relay
barks.trigger: Periodic fireteam status query from base
lines: Fireteam, sound off — I want green lights only.
Status check. Short version. Alive is a good start.
Sound off, all callsigns. Make it quick, make it honest.

barks.speaker: Relay
barks.trigger: A fireteam member's telemetry feed is lost
lines: I lost a feed — say again, anyone — talk to me!
Telemetry's flat on one of ours. Confirm status. Please.
Signal's gone dark. Marking last position. Get eyes on them.

barks.speaker: Relay
barks.trigger: Player hits critical ammunition levels and Relay is monitoring
lines: Ammo state noted. No resupply out there, so choose your arguments carefully.
Copy low ammo. Nearest reload is at base, which is not near.
You're light on shells. Lasers still work — heat's your problem now.

barks.speaker: Ekene
barks.trigger: Player idles or strays from the objective for an extended time
lines: Lodestar. The objective isn't coming to you.
Clock's running. Get back on the mission.
Wander later. Fight now.

barks.speaker: Ekene
barks.trigger: Primary objectives complete, Ekene closes the mission
lines: That's the mission. Good work, all of you. Come home.
Objectives complete. Every one of these matters. Well done.
Clean and done. The Compact owes you one more.

barks.speaker: Ekene
barks.trigger: A defense or hold phase begins
lines: Hold this ground. It's ours as long as you stand on it.
They will come hard. Stand harder.
Nobody gives an inch without my say. Understood?

barks.speaker: Ekene
barks.trigger: Player scores a notable kill while Ekene is on comms
lines: Good kill, Lodestar. Keep that discipline.
Confirmed. That's how the Compact fights.
One less gun pointed at our people.

barks.speaker: Ekene
barks.trigger: Player takes heavy sustained damage while Ekene is on comms
lines: Steady, Lodestar. Armor's doing its job. Let it.
You're taking hits. Move your feet — don't trade standing still.
Break their angle. Make them work for you.

barks.speaker: Ekene
barks.trigger: A fireteam member is lost while Ekene commands
lines: We lost one. Grieve later. Fight now.
They're down. Hold the line — we don't waste what they paid for.
Mark the position. We bring our people home. After.

barks.speaker: Ekene
barks.trigger: Fireteam is heavily damaged and morale needs steadying
lines: You're hurt, not beaten. There's a difference. Show them.
Tighten up. We've walked out of worse.
Look after each other. That's the whole doctrine.

barks.speaker: Ekene
barks.trigger: Player loses a limb while Ekene is on comms
lines: You lost the limb, not the fight. Adjust and keep on.
Still standing? Then you're still fighting.
That mech can lose parts. You can't. Fight smart.

barks.speaker: Ekene
barks.trigger: Player rides the redline repeatedly in one engagement
lines: Watch your heat. Dead heroes shut down first.
Discipline, Lodestar. Cool mech, cool head.
Ease the triggers. The war's long.

barks.speaker: Ekene
barks.trigger: Player reports critically low ammunition to command
lines: Low ammo. Every shot's a decision now. Make good ones.
Count your rounds like they're people. Spend them the same way.
Dry guns win nothing. Conserve.

barks.speaker: Ekene
barks.trigger: A strong salvage haul is logged after an engagement
lines: Good salvage. Every wreck feeds the Compact.
That's armor for our next recruit. Well fought.
We build our army from theirs. Remember that.

barks.speaker: Ekene
barks.trigger: Player mech shuts down in combat while Ekene commands
lines: Lodestar's dark — fireteam, cover them! Nobody dies today.
Shutdown on Lodestar. Close ranks. Buy the restart.
Hold your nerve, Lodestar. We hold the ground.
